Title: Tolvaptan for Children and Adolescents with Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease: Randomized Controlled Trial
Author: Mekahli et al.
Comment: No inferential statistic (p-value, risk ratio, or odds ratio) was reported by the paper for serious adverse events; only raw counts and percentages. All randomized participants took ≥1 dose, so the safety-population denominators equal the randomized denominators.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Tolvaptan (V2R antagonist), split-dose weight/tolerability-titrated regimen') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
domain: nephrology / autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease
Participant type: Children and adolescents aged 4–17 years with ADPKD and eGFR ≥60 ml/min per 1.73 m2
Recruitment source: 20 academic pediatric nephrology centers (September 2016 to November 2018)
Outcome measurement: Number (%) of participants with one or more serious treatment-emergent AEs, denominator = number randomized/treated per arm
Outcome variable: Participants with serious treatment-emergent adverse events

Report_ID: Subjects with serious TEAEs (treatment-emergent serious adverse events)
Title: The NOCTURNE Randomized Trial Comparing 2 Tolvaptan Formulations
Author: Perrone et al.
Comment: Group 1 events/total are the sum of the three tolvaptan arms as reported in Table 3 (3+1+1=5 events; 45+44+44=133 subjects); the paper itself reports only per-arm counts plus an overall total of 6 (3.4%). Denominators are the safety population (N=175), which differs slightly from the randomized population (N=177; Table 2 lists MR 80 mg n=45 and placebo n=43). No statistical test was performed on safety data ("Safety data are reported as summary statistics").; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Pooled tolvaptan (MR 50 mg + MR 80 mg + IR 60/30 mg)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group Phase 2 trial
Participant type: Adults aged 18–50 years with ADPKD (modified Ravine criteria), eGFR >45 ml/min per 1.73 m2
Recruitment source: 41 clinical trial sites in the United States
Outcome measurement: Number (%) of subjects with at least one serious TEAE out of the safety population per arm
Outcome variable: Subjects with serious TEAEs (treatment-emergent serious adverse events)
additional_group_ns: Arm-level serious TEAE counts from Table 3 pooled into group_1: tolvaptan MR 50 mg 3/45 (6.7%), tolvaptan MR 80 mg 1/44 (2.3%), tolvaptan IR 60/30 mg 1/44 (2.3%). No arm excluded.

Title: Tolvaptan in Patients with Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (TEMPO 3:4)
Author: Torres et al.
Comment: The trial does NOT report the number of patients with at least one (any) serious adverse event in either arm; Table 2 lists only per-category SAE counts (e.g. ALT elevation 9 [0.9%] vs 2 [0.4%]; chest pain 8 [0.8%] vs 2 [0.4%]; pyelonephritis 5 [0.5%] vs 5 [1.0%]). These categories cannot be summed into a composite SAE numerator without double counting patients, so no composite event counts were recorded. Denominators from Table 2 header (tolvaptan N=961, placebo N=483) are given; total randomized were 961 and 484 (1 placebo patient withdrew before receiving drug).; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Tolvaptan') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); unsupported or insufficient statistic type
Participant type: Adults 18-50 years with ADPKD, total kidney volume >=750 ml, estimated creatinine clearance >=60 ml/min
Outcome measurement: Number of patients with serious adverse events, reported only by individual MedDRA category occurring in at least 0.5% of patients in either group (Table 2); no composite 'any SAE' total reported
